module_summary: AXI-lite GPIO peripheral: skid-buffered AW/W/AR channels feed an address-decoded output register (load/set/clear/toggle) and a synchronized input block with sticky change flags, mask and interrupt.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: Write strobe when AW and W both valid and B free; enables r_gpio, mask, toggled and bvalid updates.

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: Read accept strobe from AR skid buffer; sets read valid and gates read data.

anchors.name: r_gpio
anchors.why: Software-written GPIO output register updated by load/set/clear/toggle with byte strobes.

anchors.name: o_gpio
anchors.why: GPIO output pins driven from r_gpio.

anchors.name: i_gpio
anchors.why: External GPIO inputs entering the two-flop synchronizer chain.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Skid-buffered write word address; decodes which register/operation the write targets.

anchors.name: arskd_addr
anchors.why: Skid-buffered read word address selecting which register goes to read data.

anchors.name: wskd_data
anchors.why: Skid-buffered write data applied to r_gpio, mask and toggle-clear.

anchors.name: wskd_strb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes enabling per-byte updates of r_gpio.

anchors.name: wskd_gpio
anchors.why: Strobe-merged new GPIO value used for load writes.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data from the address-muxed axil_read_data register.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid, set by write strobe, cleared by BREADY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid from axil_read_valid; gates read data reload.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid into AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid into W skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid into AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Write address ready from AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready from W skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready from AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Write response ready; clears bvalid and frees write path.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Read data ready; clears read valid and allows next read.

anchors.name: INPUT_HANDLING.qq_gpio
anchors.why: Synchronized input stage of the q/qq/last shift chain; readable input data.

anchors.name: INPUT_HANDLING.toggled
anchors.why: Sticky per-bit input change flags, set on edge, cleared by write-one.

anchors.name: INPUT_HANDLING.r_mask
anchors.why: Software interrupt mask register selecting which toggled bits raise interrupt.

anchors.name: INPUT_HANDLING.wstrb_mask
anchors.why: Strobe-merged new mask value written into r_mask.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt output: registered OR of masked toggled bits.

groups.name: AXI-lite write path
groups.description: AW and W skid buffers joined into one write strobe with registered B response.

groups.name: AXI-lite read path
groups.description: AR skid buffer and address-muxed read data register with RVALID handshake.

groups.name: GPIO output register
groups.description: Output register with load/set/clear/toggle byte-strobed writes driving o_gpio.

groups.name: Input sync and interrupt
groups.description: Two-flop input synchronizer, change detection, mask register and interrupt generation.
